integrity.computational_role: The bundled checker verifies finite symbolic identities used in the proof but is not a substitute for the cited geometric rank criterion.
integrity.proof_boundary: Global membership in the unramified parameter space and the second splitting type are proved from explicit Cox-coordinate identities; the general determinantal framework is cited.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to algebraically closed characteristic zero and the explicit class-\((4,2)\) affine family.
It classifies the pullback of the first jumping divisor to one natural parameter line, not the global geometry of every component of the full jumping locus.
The determinant reduction of the relative cohomology map is imported from arXiv:2609.39309v1 and independently checked only at the level of the printed reduced block.
title: The canonical quartic deformation has exactly two reduced normal-bundle jumps
